task: left vs right fist, executed movements (runs 3/7/11)
normalisation: pooled T0 rest within the same recording, label-free
carryover: A trial-wise pre-cue baseline was tested and rejected: the beta rebound peaks ~2.3 s after movement offset, so the pre-cue window sits on the previous trial's rebound and subtracting it injects carryover. Residual carryover is reported as the switch/stay split, not corrected.
caveat: Requires all trials from a recording at once (per-recording normalisation). Not valid for single-trial online use.
